## 模型主程式
```{r}

get_fatigue_nll_func <- function(model_type = 1, dist = "lnorm", use_gamma = TRUE) {
  
  function(par, data.t, data.censored, Stress.Amplitude) {
    min_stress <- min(Stress.Amplitude)
    
    # 如果 use_gamma = TRUE: 
    #   Model 1: 4 參數 (b0_mu, b1_mu, sigma, gamma) 
    #   Model 2: 5 參數 (b0_mu, b1_mu, b0_si, b1_si, gamma) 
    # 如果 use_gamma = FALSE:
    #   Model 1: 3 參數 (b0_mu, b1_mu, sigma) 且 gamma = 0 
    #   Model 2: 4 參數 (b0_mu, b1_mu, b0_si, b1_si) 且 gamma = 0 
    
    if (use_gamma) {
      gamma <- if(model_type == 1) par[4] else par[5]
      if(gamma >= min_stress || gamma <= 0) return(1e10)
    } else {
      gamma <- 0 # 不含疲勞極限模型 
    }
    
    stress_diff <- Stress.Amplitude - gamma
    if(any(stress_diff <= 0)) return(1e10)
    
    # mu ：beta0 + beta1 * log(S - gamma) 
    mu <- par[2] * log(stress_diff) + par[1]
    
    # sigma 
    if(model_type == 1) {
      sigma <- par[3] 
      if(sigma <= 0) return(1e10)
    } else {
      sigma <- exp(par[4] * log(Stress.Amplitude) + par[3])
      if(any(sigma <= 0) || any(!is.finite(sigma))) return(1e10)
    }
    
    # 分佈計算 (lnorm 與 weibull) 
    if(dist == "lnorm") {
      log_dens <- dlnorm(data.t, mu, sigma, log = TRUE)
      log_surv <- log(1 - pmin(plnorm(data.t, mu, sigma), 1 - 1e-15))
    } else {
      z <- (log(data.t) - mu) / sigma
      z <- pmax(pmin(z, 700), -700) 
      log_dens <- -log(sigma) - log(data.t) + z - exp(z)
      log_surv <- -exp(z)
    }
    
    lj <- data.censored * log_dens + (1 - data.censored) * log_surv
    result <- -sum(lj)
    return(if(is.finite(result)) result else 1e10)
  }
}
```

## 最佳化內初始值、上下界設置及執行
```{r}

fit_fatigue_model <- function(data, model_type = 1, dist = "lnorm", use_gamma = TRUE, initial_params = NULL) {
  
  # 1. 確保概似函數知道是否要估計 gamma
  nll_func <- get_fatigue_nll_func(model_type, dist, use_gamma = use_gamma)
  min_s <- min(data$stress)
  
  # 2. 設定初始值
  if(is.null(initial_params)) {
    if (use_gamma) {
      # 含 gamma (Model 1: 4個, Model 2: 5個)
      initial_params <- if(model_type == 1) c(16, -1.8, 0.6, 70) else c(15, -1.5, 11, -2.5, 70)
    } else {
      # 不含 gamma (Model 1: 3個, Model 2: 4個)
      initial_params <- if(model_type == 1) c(16, -1.8, 0.6) else c(15, -1.5, 11, -2.5)
    }
  }
  
  # 3. 設定 L-BFGS-B 的邊界
  n_par <- length(initial_params)
  low_b <- rep(-Inf, n_par)
  up_b <- rep(Inf, n_par)
  
  # 如果有 gamma，最後一個參數是 gamma，需設定邊界
  if (use_gamma) {
    low_b[n_par] <- 0           # gamma > 0
    up_b[n_par] <- min_s - 0.001 # gamma < min_stress
  }
  
  # 設定 sigma 必須為正值 
  if(model_type == 1) low_b[3] <- 0.0001 
  
  # 4. 執行優化
  fit <- optim(
    par = initial_params,
    fn = nll_func,
    data.t = data$cycles,
    data.censored = data$censoring,
    Stress.Amplitude = data$stress,
    method = "L-BFGS-B",
    lower = low_b,
    upper = up_b,
    hessian = TRUE,
    control = list(trace = 1)
  )
  
  # 計算 AIC
  fit$aic <- 2 * n_par + 2 * fit$value
  return(fit)
}
```

# 分位數曲線圖函數

```{r}
plot_fatigue_comparison <- function(data, fit_lnorm, fit_weibull, 
                                    m_type_ln = 1, m_type_wb = 1,
                                    use_gamma_ln = TRUE, use_gamma_wb = TRUE,maintitle="S-N Diagram Comparison") {
  
  # 1. 內部輔助函數：計算分位數 
  get_q <- function(par, p, stress, dist, m_type, use_gamma) {
    
    # 根據是否使用 gamma 來判斷參數索引位置 
    if (use_gamma) {
      gamma <- if(m_type == 1) par[4] else par[5]
    } else {
      gamma <- 0  # 若不含疲勞極限，gamma 固定為 0 
    }
    
    # 計算 mu 
    loc <- par[2] * log(stress - gamma) + par[1]
    
    # 計算 sigma 
    sig <- if(m_type == 1) {
      par[3] 
    } else {
      # Model 2: sigma = exp(b0_si + b1_si * log(S)) 
      exp(par[4] * log(stress) + par[3])
    }
    
    if(dist == "lnorm") {
      # 對數常態分位數 
      return(qlnorm(p, meanlog = loc, sdlog = sig))
    } else {
      # Weibull 分位數 (由 SEV 分佈轉換) 
      w_p <- log(-log(1 - p))
      return(exp(loc + sig * w_p))
    }
  }
  
  # --- 2. 生成繪圖數據線 ---
  stress_range <- seq(min(data$stress), max(data$stress), length.out = 100)
  probs <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
  
  plot_lines <- expand.grid(stress = stress_range, p = probs, dist = c("Lognormal", "Weibull")) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      cycles = if(dist == "Lognormal") {
        get_q(fit_lnorm$par, p, stress, "lnorm", m_type_ln, use_gamma_ln)
      } else {
        get_q(fit_weibull$par, p, stress, "weibull", m_type_wb, use_gamma_wb)
      },
      p_label = factor(paste0(p * 100, "%"), levels = c("10%", "50%", "90%"))
    )

  # --- 3. 繪圖主體 (維持您的原始格式設定) ---
  p_plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = cycles, y = stress)) + 
    geom_point(aes(shape = factor(censoring)), color = "blue", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("0" = 2, "1" = 16),
      labels = c("0" = "Runout", "1" = "Failure"),
      name = "Status"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      trans = "log", 
      breaks = scales::trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
      labels = scales::trans_format(function(x) log10(x), scales::math_format(10^.x))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      trans = "log",
      labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1)
    ) +
    geom_line(data = plot_lines, 
              aes(x = cycles, y = stress, color = p_label, linetype = dist),
              linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("10%" = "green", "50%" = "red", "90%" = "purple")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Lognormal" = "solid", "Weibull" = "dashed")) +
    labs(
      title = maintitle,
#      subtitle = paste0("LN: Model ", m_type_ln, " (Gamma: ", use_gamma_ln, ") | ",
#                        "WB: Model ", m_type_wb, " (Gamma: ", use_gamma_wb, ")"),
      x = "thousands of cycles",
      y = "stress",
      color = "Quantile",
      linetype = "Distribution"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p_plot)
}
```

## Bootstrap 信賴區間函數


```{r}

run_full_bootstrap <- function(data, model_type = 1, dist = "lnorm", 
                               use_gamma = TRUE, R = 1000, 
                               use_strata = TRUE, initial_params = NULL) {
  
  library(boot)
  library(broom)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(gridExtra)

  # --- 1. 內部統計函數 (確保初始值被正確傳入與微調) ---
  boot_stat <- function(d, i, m_type, d_type, u_gamma, init_p) {
    d_sub <- d[i, ]
    nll_func <- get_fatigue_nll_func(m_type, d_type, u_gamma)
    min_s <- min(d_sub$stress)
    
    # 決定起始值
    start_p <- if(!is.null(init_p)) init_p else {
      if(u_gamma) {
        if(m_type == 1) c(16, -1.8, 0.6, 70) else c(15, -1.5, 11, -2.5, 70)
      } else {
        if(m_type == 1) c(16, -1.8, 0.6) else c(15, -1.5, 11, -2.5)
      }
    }
    
    # 動態檢查 gamma 是否符合邊界 (gamma < min_stress)
    n_p <- length(start_p)
    if(u_gamma && start_p[n_p] >= min_s) start_p[n_p] <- min_s - 0.1
    
    # 設定邊界
    low_b <- rep(-Inf, n_p)
    up_b <- rep(Inf, n_p)
    if(u_gamma) { low_b[n_p] <- 0; up_b[n_p] <- min_s - 0.001 }
    if(m_type == 1) low_b[3] <- 0.001

    tryCatch({
      fit <- optim(par = start_p, fn = nll_func, 
                   data.t = d_sub$cycles, data.censored = d_sub$censoring, 
                   Stress.Amplitude = d_sub$stress,
                   method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = low_b, upper = up_b)
      return(fit$par)
    }, error = function(e) return(rep(NA, n_p)))
  }

  # --- 2. 執行 Bootstrap ---
  # 設定分層抽樣邏輯
  strata_arg <- if(use_strata) as.factor(data$stress) else rep(1, nrow(data))
  
  set.seed(123)
  boot_results <- boot(
    data = data, 
    statistic = boot_stat, 
    R = R, 
    strata = strata_arg,
    m_type = model_type, d_type = dist, u_gamma = use_gamma, init_p = initial_params
  )

  # --- 3. 自動命名參數標籤 ---
  if(model_type == 1) {
    labels <- c("beta0_mu", "beta1_mu", "sigma")
  } else {
    labels <- c("beta0_mu", "beta1_mu", "beta0_si", "beta1_si")
  }
  if(use_gamma) labels <- c(labels, "gamma")

  # --- 4. 建立摘要表格 ---
  boot_summary <- tidy(boot_results, conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "perc")
  boot_summary$term <- labels
  cat("\n--- Bootstrap 參數統計摘要 (95% CI: 2.5% to 97.5%) ---\n")
  print(boot_summary)

  # --- 5. 繪製分配圖 ---
  boot_df <- as.data.frame(boot_results$t)
  colnames(boot_df) <- labels
  boot_df <- na.omit(boot_df)

  plot_list <- list()
  for(i in 1:length(labels)) {
    term_name <- labels[i]
    p <- ggplot(boot_df, aes(x = .data[[term_name]])) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_density(color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = boot_results$t0[i], linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      labs(title = term_name, x = "Estimate Value", y = "Density") +
      theme_minimal()
    plot_list[[i]] <- p
  }

  # 自動排版並輸出
  grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 2)
  
  return(list(boot_obj = boot_results, summary = boot_summary))
}
```


## LRT 參數顯著性檢定
```{r}
perform_LRT <- function(negloglik1, negloglik2, df) {
  # 計算 LRT 統計量
  LRT_stat <- 2*(negloglik1 - negloglik2)
  
  # 計算 p 值
  p_val <- pchisq(LRT_stat, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  # 結果
  result <- list(
    LRT_statistic = LRT_stat,
    df = df,
    p_value = p_val,
    significant = p_val < 0.05
  )
  
  # 印出結果
  cat("=== 似然比檢驗結果 ===\n")
  cat("LRT 統計量:", round(LRT_stat, 4), "\n")
  cat("自由度:", df, "\n")
  cat("p 值:", format(p_val, scientific = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("顯著性 (α = 0.05):", ifelse(p_val < 0.05, "顯著", "不顯著"), "\n")
  
  return(result)
}
```

## 結果整理輔助函數
```{r}
# 將 lnorm 與 weibull 兩組 fit 結果整理為對照表。
# model_type 與 use_gamma 決定欄位組成（與 get_fatigue_nll_func 的參數順序一致）。
build_comparison_table <- function(fit_ln, fit_wb, model_type = 1, use_gamma = TRUE) {
  tbl <- list(
    Distribution = c("Lognormal", "Weibull"),
    AIC = round(c(fit_ln$aic, fit_wb$aic), 4),
    NLL = round(c(fit_ln$value, fit_wb$value), 4),
    beta0_mu = round(c(fit_ln$par[1], fit_wb$par[1]), 4),
    beta1_mu = round(c(fit_ln$par[2], fit_wb$par[2]), 4)
  )

  if (model_type == 1) {
    tbl$sigma <- round(c(fit_ln$par[3], fit_wb$par[3]), 4)
    if (use_gamma) tbl$fatigue_limit <- round(c(fit_ln$par[4], fit_wb$par[4]), 4)
  } else {
    tbl$sigma_0 <- round(c(fit_ln$par[3], fit_wb$par[3]), 4)
    tbl$sigma_1 <- round(c(fit_ln$par[4], fit_wb$par[4]), 4)
    if (use_gamma) tbl$fatigue_limit <- round(c(fit_ln$par[5], fit_wb$par[5]), 4)
  }

  tbl$Convergence <- c(fit_ln$convergence, fit_wb$convergence)
  as.data.frame(tbl)
}

# 從 bootstrap 物件取出指定參數的 BCa 95% CI 並印出（預設取 gamma，index = 4）
print_gamma_bca_ci <- function(boot_obj, index = 4) {
  ci <- boot::boot.ci(boot_obj, type = "bca", index = index)
  cat(sprintf("BCa 95%% CI for gamma: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", ci$bca[4], ci$bca[5]))
  invisible(ci)
}
```

## LRT 模型一與模型二
$\sigma_1$ 


## weighted bootstrap

```{r}
get_fatigue_nll_func_weighted <- function(model_type = 1, dist = "lnorm", use_gamma = TRUE) {
  
  # 增加 weights 參數
  function(par, data.t, data.censored, Stress.Amplitude, weights = NULL) {
    n <- length(data.t)
    # 如果沒給權重，預設設為 1 (即傳統 MLE)
    if(is.null(weights)) weights <- rep(1, n)
    
    min_stress <- min(Stress.Amplitude)
    
    # --- 參數提取與邊界檢查 (同您的原始 code) ---
    if (use_gamma) {
      gamma <- if(model_type == 1) par[4] else par[5]
      if(gamma >= min_stress || gamma <= 0) return(1e10)
    } else {
      gamma <- 0
    }
    
    stress_diff <- Stress.Amplitude - gamma
    if(any(stress_diff <= 0)) return(1e10)
    
    mu <- par[2] * log(stress_diff) + par[1]
    
    if(model_type == 1) {
      sigma <- par[3] 
      if(sigma <= 0) return(1e10)
    } else {
      sigma <- exp(par[4] * log(Stress.Amplitude) + par[3])
      if(any(sigma <= 0) || any(!is.finite(sigma))) return(1e10)
    }
    
    # --- 分佈計算 (同您的原始 code) ---
    if(dist == "lnorm") {
      log_dens <- dlnorm(data.t, mu, sigma, log = TRUE)
      log_surv <- log(1 - pmin(plnorm(data.t, mu, sigma), 1 - 1e-15))
    } else {
      z <- (log(data.t) - mu) / sigma
      z <- pmax(pmin(z, 700), -700) 
      log_dens <- -log(sigma) - log(data.t) + z - exp(z)
      log_surv <- -exp(z)
    }
    
    # --- 關鍵修正：套用權重 ---
    # lj 為向量，長度等於 n
    lj <- data.censored * log_dens + (1 - data.censored) * log_surv
    
    # 將每個觀測值的貢獻乘以其對應權重再加總
    result <- -sum(weights * lj) 
    
    return(if(is.finite(result)) result else 1e10)
  }
}
```


```{r}
library(fwb)

run_fwb_analysis <- function(data, model_type = 1, dist = "lnorm", use_gamma = TRUE, R = 1000, initial_params = NULL) {
  
  # 取得加權版 NLL 函數
  nll_weighted <- get_fatigue_nll_func_weighted(model_type, dist, use_gamma)
  min_s <- min(data$stress)
  
  # 1. 取得資料中所有唯一的應力水平（排序後方便對照結果）
  unique_stresses <- sort(unique(data$stress))
  p_levels <- c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
  
  # 2. 設定初始值與邊界
  if(is.null(initial_params)) {
    if (use_gamma) {
      # Model 1: (b0_mu, b1_mu, sigma, gamma)
      initial_params <- if(model_type == 1) c(16.444, -1.792, 0.634, 70.642) else c(15, -1.5, 11, -2.5, 70)
    } else {
      initial_params <- if(model_type == 1) c(16, -1.8, 0.6) else c(15, -1.5, 11, -2.5)
    }
  }
  
  n_par <- length(initial_params)
  low_b <- rep(-Inf, n_par); up_b <- rep(Inf, n_par)
  if (use_gamma) {
    low_b[n_par] <- 0
    up_b[n_par] <- min_s - 0.001
  }
  if(model_type == 1) low_b[3] <- 0.0001
  
  # --- 定義 fwb 專用的統計函數 ---
  fwb_stat <- function(d, w) {
    # 預先計算總回傳長度，以便出錯時回傳相同長度的 NA 向量
    num_pars <- length(initial_params)
    num_stresses <- length(unique_stresses)
    total_return_length <- num_pars + (length(p_levels) * num_stresses)
    
    # 使用 tryCatch 包裹優化過程
    result_vec <- tryCatch({
      # A. 執行優化尋找參數
      fit <- optim(
        par = initial_params,
        fn = nll_weighted,
        data.t = d$cycles,
        data.censored = d$censoring,
        Stress.Amplitude = d$stress,
        weights = w, 
        method = "L-BFGS-B",
        lower = low_b,
        upper = up_b
      )
      
      pars <- fit$par
      
      # 內部計算邏輯 (分位數計算)
      calc_quantiles <- function(s, p) {
        gamma_val <- if(use_gamma) (if(model_type == 1) pars[4] else pars[5]) else 0
        location <- pars[2] * log(s - gamma_val) + pars[1]
        current_sigma <- if(model_type == 1) pars[3] else exp(pars[4] * log(s) + pars[3])
        
        if(dist == "lnorm") {
          q_std <- qnorm(p)
        } else {
          q_std <- log(-log(1 - p))
        }
        return(location + q_std * current_sigma)
      }
      
      all_quantiles <- as.vector(sapply(p_levels, function(p) {
        sapply(unique_stresses, function(s) calc_quantiles(s, p))
      }))
      
      # 正常回傳
      c(pars, all_quantiles)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      # 當錯誤發生時（例如梯度的非有限值），回傳一組長度正確的 NA 向量
      # 這會讓該輪 Bootstrap 被紀錄為失效，但不會中斷整個 R = 1000 的循環
      return(rep(NA, total_return_length))
    })
    
    return(result_vec)
  }
  
  # --- 執行 Fractional Weighted Bootstrap ---
  cat("正在執行 Fractional Weighted Bootstrap (R =", R, ")...\n")
  fwb_out <- fwb(data = data, statistic = fwb_stat, R = R)
  
  # 為結果加上名稱標籤，方便後續分析
  param_names <- if(model_type == 1) c("b0", "b1", "sigma") else c("b0", "b1", "b0_si", "b1_si")
  if(use_gamma) param_names <- c(param_names, "gamma")
  
  quantile_names <- as.vector(t(outer(paste0("p", p_levels), paste0("_s", unique_stresses), paste0)))
  colnames(fwb_out$t) <- c(param_names, quantile_names)
  
  return(fwb_out)
}
```
```{r}
library(fwb)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(gridExtra)
library(dplyr)
summarize_and_plot_fwb <- function(fwb_results, model_dist_name = "Model") {
  
  # 1. 定義標籤 (根據你的 run_fwb_analysis 內部定義)
  # 基本參數固定為 4 個: b0, b1, sigma, gamma
  base_labels <- c("b0", "b1", "sigma", "gamma")
  
  # 2. 建立摘要表格 (使用 tidy 函數)
  # fwb 支援 tidy 函數來快速提取點估計值與百分位信賴區間 (perc)
  boot_summary <- tidy(fwb_results, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95, conf.method = "perc")
  
  # 由於 tidy 對 fwb 的預設 term 可能只是 index，我們手動加上標籤
  # 注意：fwb_results$t 包含了參數與分位數，這裡我們只取前 4 個參數
  boot_summary <- boot_summary[1:4, ]
  boot_summary$term <- base_labels
  
  cat(paste0("\n--- ", model_dist_name, " 參數統計摘要 (95% CI: Percentile Method) ---\n"))
  print(boot_summary)

  # 3. 準備繪圖數據 (轉換為 Data Frame 並移除 NA)
  boot_df <- as.data.frame(fwb_results$t[, 1:4])
  colnames(boot_df) <- base_labels
  boot_df <- na.omit(boot_df)

  # 4. 迴圈繪製分配圖
  plot_list <- list()
  for(i in 1:length(base_labels)) {
    term_name <- base_labels[i]
    t0_value <- fwb_results$t0[i]
    
    p <- ggplot(boot_df, aes(x = .data[[term_name]])) +
      geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_density(color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = t0_value, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.8) +
      annotate("text", x = t0_value, y = 0, label = "MLE", vjust = -1, angle = 90, size = 3) +
      labs(title = paste(model_dist_name, "-", term_name), 
           x = "Bootstrap Estimate", y = "Density") +
      theme_minimal()
    
    plot_list[[i]] <- p
  }

  # 5. 自動排版輸出 (2x2 矩陣)
  grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 2)
  
  return(list(summary = boot_summary, clean_data = boot_df))
}
```

```{r}
# 執行 Lognormal (對數常態) 分析
fwb_results_ln <- run_fwb_analysis(data, model_type = 1, dist = "lnorm", R = 1000,initial_params = c(6.675,-1.409,0.253,6.022))
#執行 Weibull (韋伯) 分析
fwb_results_wb <- run_fwb_analysis(data, model_type = 1, dist = "weibull", R = 1000,initial_params = c(6.549,-1.318,0.216,6.455))

# 定義一個簡化函數來提取 95% 邊界資料 (整合自您提供的 logic)
get_distribution_bands_v2 <- function(fwb_res, data) {
  stress_tags <- sort(unique(data$stress))
  boot_matrix <- fwb_res$t
  
  # 定義感興趣的壽命百分位數 (p0.1, p0.5, p0.9)
  p_levels <- c("0.1", "0.5", "0.9")
  
  # 建立一個空清單來儲存結果，最後再合併
  res_list <- list()
  
  for (s_val in stress_tags) {
    # 建立該應力下的暫存資料框
    stress_res <- data.frame(stress = s_val)
    
    for (p in p_levels) {
      # 精確匹配該應力下的特定分位數欄位，例如 "p0.1_s450"
      # 假設 boot_matrix 的欄位命名規則為 p[分位數]_s[應力值]
      col_name <- paste0("p", p, "_s", s_val)
      
      if (col_name %in% colnames(boot_matrix)) {
        vals <- boot_matrix[, col_name]
        vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
        
        if (length(vals) > 0) {
          # 分別存入該分位數的 Lower (0.025) 與 Upper (0.975)
          # 並依據文獻方法轉換回原始循環數 (exp) [cite: 172, 182]
          stress_res[paste0("p", p, "_Lower")] <- exp(quantile(vals, 0.025))
          stress_res[paste0("p", p, "_Upper")] <- exp(quantile(vals, 0.975))
        }
      }
    }
    res_list[[as.character(s_val)]] <- stress_res
  }
  
  # 合併所有應力的結果
  final_table <- do.call(rbind, res_list)
  return(final_table)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 將 wide 格式的信賴帶（plot_bands_*）轉為 long 格式：stress, Quantile, Lower, Upper, Distribution
to_long_bands <- function(bands_wide, distribution) {
  bands_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("p"),
      names_to = c("Quantile", ".value"),
      names_pattern = "p(.+)_(Lower|Upper)"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Quantile = factor(paste0(as.numeric(Quantile) * 100, "%"),
                        levels = c("10%", "50%", "90%")),
      Distribution = distribution
    )
}

bands_long <- bind_rows(
  to_long_bands(plot_bands_ln, "Lognormal"),
  to_long_bands(plot_bands_wb, "Weibull")
)

# 視覺參數（Weibull 陰影較淺以減少視覺壓力）
alpha_fill_map <- c("Lognormal" = 0.5, "Weibull" = 0.25)
line_lwd       <- 0.7

p_final <- ggplot() +
  # 信賴帶陰影：以 Quantile 配色、依分佈調整透明度
  geom_ribbon(data = bands_long,
              aes(y = stress, xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper,
                  fill = Quantile, alpha = Distribution,
                  group = interaction(Distribution, Quantile)),
              orientation = "y") +
  # 上下界線：依分佈使用實線（Lognormal）／虛線（Weibull）
  geom_line(data = bands_long,
            aes(y = stress, x = Lower, color = Quantile,
                linetype = Distribution,
                group = interaction(Distribution, Quantile)),
            linewidth = line_lwd) +
  geom_line(data = bands_long,
            aes(y = stress, x = Upper, color = Quantile,
                linetype = Distribution,
                group = interaction(Distribution, Quantile)),
            linewidth = line_lwd) +
  # 觀測點
  geom_point(data = data, aes(x = cycles, y = stress, shape = factor(censoring)),
             color = "blue", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("10%" = "green", "50%" = "red", "90%" = "purple"),
                     name = "Quantile") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("10%" = "green", "50%" = "red", "90%" = "purple"),
                    name = "Quantile C.I.") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Lognormal" = "solid", "Weibull" = "dashed"),
                        name = "Distribution") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = alpha_fill_map, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("0" = 2, "1" = 16),
                     labels = c("0" = "Runout", "1" = "Failure"),
                     name = "Status") +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log",
                     breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x) 10^x),
                     labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log", labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title = "S-N diagram of final model with 95% C.I. for annealed electrolytic copper wire",
       subtitle = "the confident interval of quantile",
       x = "thousands of cycles ", y = "stress") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right")

print(p_final)
```
